variant_desc: Full Fisher-Yates of n=1e6 then take first k=100 -> selection-sampling variant doing only k swaps (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
novelty_rationale: Tests algorithmic recognition that 'shuffle then take k' is equivalent to a k-step selection-sampling Fisher-Yates variant. No compiler converts a full O(n) shuffle into the O(k) Knuth-Algorithm-S variant; requires the model to reason about sampling theory rather than per-loop micro-optimization.
